map.计算两个三维向量的叉积: Compute the cross product of two 3D vectors
map.结果向量垂直于原来的两个向量: The result vector is perpendicular to both original vectors
map.同时给出模长，可用于算平行四边形面积: Also gives the magnitude, usable for the parallelogram area
map.适用于图形学、物理力矩等场景: Suited to graphics, physical torque and similar scenarios
map.求三维法向量、面积、力矩方向。: Find 3D normal vectors, areas and torque directions.
map.做图形或物理计算：由两条边求法向量，用于判断面朝向、计算平行四边形面积与力矩。: For graphics or physics: get a normal from two edges to judge face orientation, compute parallelogram area and torque.
map.填向量 a 的三个分量 a₁、a₂、a₃: Enter the three components a₁, a₂, a₃ of vector a
map.填向量 b 的三个分量 b₁、b₂、b₃: Enter the three components b₁, b₂, b₃ of vector b
map.点计算得到叉积向量及其模长: Click calculate to get the cross product vector and its magnitude
map.叉积模长等于 |a||b|sinθ，即以两向量为边的平行四边形面积: The cross-product magnitude equals |a||b|sinθ, the area of the parallelogram spanned by the two vectors
map.交换 a、b 的顺序结果反号，方向判断按右手定则: Swapping a and b flips the sign; determine direction by the right-hand rule
map.若预期它们不平行，应检查输入是否有误或存在数值精度问题: If they were expected to be non-parallel, check for input errors or numerical precision issues
map.由右手定则确定，且垂直于两输入向量。: Determined by the right-hand rule, and perpendicular to both input vectors.
map.说明两个向量平行（共线）——夹角为 0° 或 180°，此时叉积模长 |a||b: It means the two vectors are parallel (collinear)—the angle is 0° or 180°, so the cross-product magnitude |a||b|sinθ = 0 and the parallelogram area is 0. Geometrically that means three points are collinear or the vectors point the same way. If they were expected to be non-parallel, check for input errors or numerical precision issues.
